name: Artifact Reforged
summary:
Artifact Reforged is a persistent, real-time strategy game for the browser and mobile, where every player shares one living world.

Start with a band of settlers and a few troops. Found your first city, zone farms, lumber mills, quarries and furnaces, and grow your population. Train infantry, archers, cavalry, catapults, scouts and warships, and send them across a map of plains, forests, mountains, rivers and seas. Your troops tire, need feeding and gain experience. Your cities need food, rest and defending.

Victory goes to whoever finds and holds the eight Artifacts, ancient relics scattered across the world. Each one grants its holder a unique power. No one gets there alone: form alliances, share sight and armies, negotiate truces, or betray your friends when the moment is right.
